generation_rules.instruction: Within {regions}, use only the hue families already assigned by the palette bindings. generation_rules.instruction: Within {regions}, preserve the existing surfaces and lighting while forming subtle light-to-dark variation inside each assigned hue family. Do not turn the whole background into a gradient, change time of day, or smooth away object boundaries.

Existing thicker portions may transmit less light; preserve local value/chroma attenuation within the assigned colour families. Do not turn glass opaque, recolour protected transmitted objects or invent a container.
